app.name: Property Ledger
app.description: Expenses, rent and each owner's share for jointly owned buildings.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noExpensesBody: Add this month's expenses, meter readings and recurring costs to see the totals here.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.emptyBody: Electricity, caretaker, service charge, taxes and repairs will be listed here by month.
expenses.tenantNotCounted: Bills the tenant pays are listed for reference and not counted.

rent.title: Rent
rent.emptyBody: Flats, tenants, payments and dues will be tracked here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.emptyBody: Monthly statements for each owner will be available here as PDF and Excel files.

update.ready: A new version of the app is ready.

money.invalid: Enter an amount in taka, such as 1,500 or 1500.50

split.noShares: This split needs the building's ownership shares
split.singleOwnerRequired: Choose the owner who bears this cost
split.percentTotal: Percentages must add up to exactly 100%
split.amountTotal: Owner amounts must add up to the total

split.duplicateOwner: Each owner can appear only once

shares.bpPositive: Each share must be more than 0%

shares.effectiveFromTaken: This building already has shares starting this month

tariff.slabsIncreasing: Each slab must end above the one before it
tariff.lastSlabOpen: Only the last slab has no upper limit
tariff.fixedChargeInvalid: Enter a fixed charge of 0 or more
tariff.subMeterOnly: Only sub meters have a tariff
tariff.effectiveFromTaken: This meter already has a tariff starting this month

reading.invalidUnits: Enter a whole number of units
reading.lowerThanPrevious: This reading is lower than the previous one. Tick "Meter reset" if the meter was replaced.
reading.noTariff: Set up a tariff for this meter first
reading.higherThanNext: This reading is higher than a later month's reading
reading.notLatest: Only a meter's latest reading can be deleted

period.tooFarAhead: Choose a month no later than next month

percent.invalid: Enter a percentage such as 50 or 33.33

owner.holdsShares: This owner holds shares. Remove them from every share set first.

building.nameTaken: A building with this name already exists
building.inUse: This building has meters, expenses or recurring costs, so it cannot be deleted

category.splitRuleInvalid: Choose by ownership share or equally

category.inUse: This category is used by expenses, meters or recurring costs. You can hide it instead.

meter.parentInvalid: Choose a postpaid or prepaid meter of this building

meter.inUse: This meter has readings or bills, so it cannot be deleted. Mark it as not in use instead.

template.categoryInvalid: Choose a category that is not for meters

building.name: Building name
building.groupHint: Optional, to group buildings, such as by area

shares.effectiveFromHint: These shares apply from this month onwards. Earlier months keep their shares.

profile.title: About you
profile.body: You are the owner who records everything. Co-owners do not use the app.

buildings.title: Your buildings
buildings.body: Add each building you own with others. You can add details later.

owners.title: Co-owners
owners.body: Add the people who share ownership with you.

shares.title: Ownership shares
shares.body: Enter each owner's percentage of every building. Expenses and rent are split by these shares.
shares.needOwnersAndBuildings: Add buildings first. You can set shares later from More.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Expense categories are ready. You can change anything later from More.
done.installBody: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to home screen". The app then opens like any other app and works without internet.

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.emptyBody: Add the buildings you own with others.

sharesPage.title: Shares in {{building}}
sharesPage.emptyBody: Expenses of this building cannot be split until its ownership shares are set.

category.name: Category name
category.defaultSplitRuleHint: Each expense can still use a different split.

meter.label: Meter name
meter.typeHint: Postpaid: a monthly bill from the utility. Prepaid: recharged in advance. Sub meter: read each month and billed with your own tariff.
meter.payerHint: Bills a tenant pays are kept for reference only and are not split between owners.
meter.parentHint: The meter this sub meter sits under. That meter's bill already includes this usage, so readings here create no expense of their own.

meters.title: Meters in {{building}}
meters.emptyBody: Add this building's electricity meters: postpaid, prepaid and sub meters.
meters.noTariffs: No tariff yet. Readings of this meter cannot be billed until it has one.

tariff.effectiveFromHint: Readings from this month onwards use this tariff. Bills already saved keep their amounts.
tariff.copiedFrom: Rates copied from {{meter}}. Change them if this meter is billed differently.

slabModes.PROGRESSIVE: Each slab at its own rate
slabModes.SINGLE_BAND: All units at the rate of the slab reached

tariff.fixedChargeHint: Demand charge or meter rent. 0 if none.
tariff.vatOnFixed: Charge VAT on the fixed charge too
tariff.previewIncomplete: Fill in the rates to see the bill.

expenseForm.periodHint: The month this cost belongs to
expenseForm.unpaidHint: Unpaid bills are listed under Bills to pay until you mark them paid.
expenseForm.previewEmpty: Enter an amount to see each owner's share.
expenseForm.tenantPaid: Kept for reference only: not split between owners and not counted in totals.
expenseForm.fromReading: Worked out from the meter reading for {{month}}. Change the reading to change it.

meterEntry.tenantPays: The tenant pays this meter, so this is kept for reference only: it is not split between owners or counted in totals.
meterEntry.duplicate: This meter already has a bill for {{month}}. Save only if this is a second bill.

readings.title: Meter readings
readings.first: First reading: it sets the starting point
readings.tenantPays: Reading only: the tenant pays this meter
readings.manualUnitsHint: Leave empty to start counting from this reading
readings.highUsage: Much higher than the last bills. Check the reading.
readings.empty: No sub meters in this building
readings.emptyBody: Add sub meters to enter their readings here.

recurring.title: Recurring costs in {{building}}
recurring.emptyBody: Add costs that come back every month, quarter or year, such as the caretaker's salary. Each one gives you a draft to confirm.
recurring.paidByHint: Drafts are marked as paid by this owner. You can change it when you confirm.
recurring.draftsHint: A draft is created for each month it is due, up to this month. Confirm them on "Confirm this month".

confirm.title: Confirm this month
confirm.earlier_one: {{count}} draft from an earlier month is waiting.
confirm.earlier_other: {{count}} drafts from earlier months are waiting.
confirm.emptyBody: Drafts from your recurring costs appear here each month.
confirm.useFromNowOn: Also use this amount from now on

expenseDetail.sharesDraft: Shares are worked out when you confirm it.
expenseDetail.sharesTenant: The tenant pays this bill, so it is not shared between owners.
expenseDetail.fromReading: This bill comes from the meter reading for {{month}}. Change or delete the reading to change it.

backup.title: Backup file
backup.moreDetail: Save all data to a file, or restore one
backup.saveBody: The file holds all your data. Keep it somewhere safe, such as your Google Drive or a WhatsApp message to yourself.
backup.restoreBody: Restoring replaces all data on this device with the data in the file. Save a backup of this device first if it has data you want to keep.
backup.replaceWarning: All data on this device will be replaced.
